name: 02-leave-the-house
objective: Get out of Red's house and into Pallet Town. The stairs down are at (7,1) on the bedroom floor; on the ground floor the front door is the pair of mats at (2,7) and (3,7). A Gen 1 door fires when you step *through* it, so standing on the mat is not leaving.
evidence: map=0x00 — wCurMap $D35E. PALLET_TOWN is const index 0. The cartridge sets no event flag for walking out of the house, so the map id is the most exact record there is.
